Hi Sarah — I need to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting. I'd like to keep it to 30 minutes. Looking at my week, the gaps I have are:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Which of those works for you? If none do, tell me a time that suits you and I'll see what I can move.

Hello — I'm setting up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week (week of Nov 23). Could you tell me whether the official department schedule has anything next week that touches CSE455 (lectures, seminars, university meetings)? I want to avoid a clash before I fix a time.

**CSE455**
- Mon 14:30–15:20 lecture (Prof. Alvarez)
- Mon 16:30–17:00 office hours (Prof. Alvarez)

**Department/university meetings**

- Fri 12:30–13:20 Colloquium · Fri 14:50–15:50 Seminar

I don't know anyone's private appointments, and I don't fix times for other people's meetings — this is just the official schedule.
Hi Professor — Tue 15:00-15:30 works for me. I've put the CSE455 staff meeting in my calendar then, 30 minutes. See you Tuesday.

Correction before you pick — I've just cross-checked the official department schedule for next week, and two of the slots I offered don't hold: Mon 14:00–14:30 has a seminar (14:10–15:40) and Tue 11:00–11:30 runs into the Tuesday seminar (ends 11:10). Sorry about that.

- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30

- Wed 13:00–13:30

Wednesday 13:00–13:30 or Monday 10:00–10:30 are my preference. Which suits you?
